hypothesis: Blind geothermal feeder faults missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS surface catalogue align microseismicity into anisotropic linear fabrics, localise geodetic strain with a characteristic shear-versus-dilatation partition, and offset magnetic/gravity basement so their potential-field edge persists under upward continuation and coarse-scale smoothing while shallow volcanic/lithologic edges decay.
named_non_fault_mimic: Volcanic seismic swarms and magmatic centres (isotropic/blob-like seismicity with shallow magnetic edges) and regional Walker-Lane-scale strain gradients with no local structure.
inputs: SHA-pinned local files only: data/training_features.tif bands 4,7,8,10,13,14,16 (tags verified); data/external/geodawn_extensions_u8.tif band 4 TMI_up150. No new external download. existing_faults.tif is never read by the SEPA feature builder.
leakage_canary: every input feature alone, symmetric AUC <= 0.90 on withheld positives, both seeds, before trusting any result

promotion_bar.rule: Exp3 pooled HOLDOUT-DTI point estimate > 0.202947 AND paired delta vs H88-ADHR (same folds) 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND fingerprint share_le2 == 0 and share_gt25 >= 0.35 AND v4 uniqueness pass (IR-88-127). Otherwise verdict negative, file marked DO-NOT-SUBMIT.

production_design.collar: d_cat > 2.5 px; zero dots on existing_faults.tif; zero outside footprint
production_design.values: binary {0.0, 1.0} float32, zeros outside footprint, nodata undeclared, sample-parity LZW layout

uniqueness_policy: IR-88-127 v4: |Spearman| <= 0.90 vs every registry raster (surface pre-placement AND final); forward 3px dot overlap <= 0.70 vs every dot-field registry raster; chance-corrected excess overlap <= 0.70 vs every discriminating dense raster; literal overlap vs the space-filling continuous 17GEMSDOE proba surface is reported verbatim (expected 1.0 for any nonempty raster) and binds via rank correlation only, because that raster contains no dots. Both readings are published; nothing is hidden.
